mentions.name: gthumb.ai
mentions.description: Platform combining AI models and open source robotics for food production, aimed at small-scale agriculture such as backyard gardening, subsistence farming, urban gardening, and other forms of small-scale growing. Its first IoT device, greenbox, is in an open beta for 2026, and the project commits to 100% right-to-repair for all equipment it offers, on the principle that no one owns nature.
mentions.audience: Backyard gardeners, subsistence farmers, urban gardeners, and other small-scale agriculture growers
mentions.source_excerpt:
gthumb.ai

AI models and open source robotics for food production.

From backyard gardening, subsistence farming, urban gardening, and other forms of small scale agriculture.

We believe no one owns nature and that all growers have 100% right to repair any equipment we offer.

Our first IOT device (greenbox) is in an open beta for 2026.
